definition_zh: 取来；接来；去拿；卖给；吸引住
definition_en: to go somewhere and bring back someone or something
core_image: 跑一趟再回来：人离开原地，把要的东西带回到出发点
scene: 狗把球甩进了草丛，主人朝它招手。The dog ran into the grass to fetch the ball.
sceneCN: 这里 fetch 是「取来、衔回」（第 1 个义项：去把东西拿回来）；句意为狗跑进草丛把球衔回来。

pos.zh: 动词：去取来、去接来；衔回
及物动词：卖得（某价钱）；吸引、使着迷

derivatives.zh: 由现在分词转化而来，义为「迷人的、动人的」，是语义的偏移美化
与本词同场的近义表达取回动作，属同义联想而非同源派生

senses.title: To go and bring something back
senses.definition: to go to a place, get something, and carry it back to where you started
senses.definitionCN: 去某个地方拿到东西，再带回出发的地方
senses.example: Please fetch my glasses from the bedroom.
senses.exampleCN: 请到卧室把我的眼镜拿来。
senses.why: The core image is a round trip: leave, get, return with the thing in hand.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是跑一个来回：离开、拿到、带着东西返回原地。

senses.title: To go and bring a person back
senses.definition: to go to where someone is and bring them back with you
senses.definitionCN: 到某人所在之处把人接回来
senses.example: I will fetch the kids from school at four.
senses.exampleCN: 我四点去学校接孩子们。
senses.why: The same round trip applies to people instead of objects.
senses.whyCN: 同样的来回行程，只是对象从物换成了人。

senses.title: To sell for a price
senses.definition: to be sold for a particular amount of money
senses.definitionCN: 以某个价钱卖出
senses.example: The old painting fetched over a million yuan.
senses.exampleCN: 那幅旧画卖了一百多万元。
senses.why: The thing travels away from you like a returned object, and money comes back in its place.
senses.whyCN: 物品像被衔回的东西一样离开你，回来的是钱，由此长出售价义。

senses.title: To interest or attract someone
senses.definition: to be interesting or attractive enough to hold someone's attention
senses.definitionCN: 足够有趣或动人，能抓住某人的注意力
senses.example: That strange story really fetched the whole class.
senses.exampleCN: 那个奇怪的故事把全班都吸引住了。
senses.why: What is brought back from a trip is attention itself, so the mind is carried away and returned.
senses.whyCN: 被带回来的其实是注意力，心被带走又被送回，于是有了吸引义。

intro.en: Fetch goes straight back to Old English, where the same verb meant to pursue and obtain.
intro.cn: fetch 直接来自古英语，同一个动词当时就表示追赶并拿到。

items.en: A Germanic verb family about pursuing and getting underlies the word.
items.cn: underlying 是一个关于追赶和获取的日耳曼语动词家族。

items.en: Old English feccan meant to fetch, to seek and bring back.
items.cn: 古英语 feccan 表示去取、寻找并带回。

items.en: The spelling settled as fecchen, keeping the bring-back meaning.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写定为 fecchen，保留带回的含义。

items.en: The price sense appeared later, then the informal attract sense.
items.cn: 现代英语中先出现售价义，后又产生口语化的吸引义。

items.en: The modern language keeps the word in daily use.
items.cn: 现代英语仍在日常使用该词。

note.en: Fetch, bring, take and get are easy to mix because they all move things around.
note.cn: fetch、bring、take、get 都在搬东西，容易混用。

entries.definition: the past tense of fetch
entries.definitionCN: fetch 的过去式，表示已经取来

entries.definition: to cut a design into a surface with acid; only spelled similarly
entries.definitionCN: 用酸在表面刻出图案；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a quick rough drawing; only looks similar at the end
entries.definitionCN: 速写、草图；只是结尾拼写相近，并非同源

entries.definition: to carry something toward the speaker
entries.definitionCN: 把某物带向说话者一方，强调方向

entries.definition: to carry something away from the speaker
entries.definitionCN: 把某物从说话者一方带走，方向相反

entries.definition: to obtain or receive something in any way
entries.definitionCN: 以任何方式获得或拿到，比 fetch 更笼统

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to keep fetch on the tip of your tongue.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子，让 fetch 随叫随到。

normal.en: Fetch sounds like a short dash: a quick trip out and back with the thing in hand.
normal.cn: fetch 听起来像一次短促冲刺：跑出去、带回来。

normal.en: A dog owner says fetch, and the dog does the round trip.
normal.cn: 主人喊 fetch，狗就完成一趟来回。

normal.en: Think of fetch water: you leave the tap empty-handed and return with a full bucket.
normal.cn: 想 fetch water：空手去水龙头，提着满桶回来。

normal.en: In markets, the goods fetch money, the round trip ends with cash instead of goods.
normal.cn: 在市场里，货物 fetch 出价钱，往返的结果是换回现金。

normal.en: Fetch and carry describes someone always running small errands.
normal.cn: fetch and carry 形容总在跑腿打杂的人。

abstract.en: Every fetch has two ends: where you leave and where you return.
abstract.cn: 每次 fetch 都有两个端点：出发地与返回地。

abstract.en: Picture an arrow that goes out and curls back like a boomerang.
abstract.cn: 想象一支飞出去又回旋的箭，去而复返。

abstract.en: The word itself travels: it leaves your mouth and brings the action back to your feet.
abstract.cn: 这个词自己也在旅行：从嘴里出发，把动作带回脚边。

examples.en: Could you fetch me a glass of water?
examples.cn: 你能给我取一杯水来吗？

examples.en: The house fetched a high price at the auction.
examples.cn: 那栋房子在拍卖会上卖出了高价。

examples.en: She taught her puppy to fetch sticks.
examples.cn: 她教小狗去衔木棍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「费气」——取东西来回跑，费一趟气力；fetch 就是费气跑腿拿回来

root: 日耳曼语源，一般认为与表示「追赶、拿到」的古英语动词家族有关；不涉及拉丁词根，同源词极少。

sensesIntro.en: From a round trip with objects to people, then to prices and attention.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从带物往返展开，延伸到接人、售价，再到吸引注意力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round trip that ends with the thing in hand
core.cn: 核心意象：一个以带回目标物收尾的来回

branches.en: money comes back instead of goods
attention is carried away and returned
branches.cn: 注意力被带走又被送回

intro.en: Fetch is a single Old English verb, so its word family is small.
intro.cn: fetch 是单一的古英语动词，词族不大。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin relative; the word stayed inside the Germanic family.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词，这个词一直留在日耳曼语家族里。

items.example: feccan already meant fetch in Old English.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 feccan 已有取回义。

items.example: The dog fetches the ball every time.
He fetched a ladder for me.
The boat was fetching water slowly.
items.exampleCN: 船正慢慢进水，取水场景在此。

items.example: She spent the day fetching and carrying.

items.meaningCN: 最终到达（常指出乎意料）
items.example: We fetched up at a small inn.
items.exampleCN: 我们最后到了一家小客栈。

items.example: Fetch in the washing before it rains.
items.exampleCN: 下雨前把洗的衣物收进来。

items.meaning: to bring out or draw attention to
items.example: The light fetched out the colors of the painting.
items.exampleCN: 灯光使画上的颜色显现出来。

items.meaning: to bring down from a height
items.example: Fetch down that box from the shelf.
items.exampleCN: 把那个盒子从架子上取下来。
她戴了一顶迷人的帽子。

definition_zh: 小说；虚构的事；编造的话
definition_en: a story made up from imagination, or something invented rather than true
core_image: 被写出来却不存在的世界：纸上的故事没有发生，却让人相信
scene: 书店角落的小说区亮着暖灯，孩子挑了一本冒险故事。She picked a science fiction novel from the shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 fiction 是「小说」（第 1 个义项：想象出来的故事作品）；句意为她从书架上挑了一本科幻小说。

pos.zh: 名词：小说；虚构作品
名词：虚构之事；编造的谎言

derivatives.zh: 由 fiction 加形容词后缀构成，义为「虚构的、小说式的」
来自同根拉丁形容词，义为「假想的、编造出来的」
加施动者后缀，指虚构写作者，较少用

senses.title: Novels and made-up stories
senses.definition: books and stories about imaginary people and events
senses.definitionCN: 关于想象中人物与事件的书和故事
senses.example: She reads fiction every night before bed.
senses.exampleCN: 她每晚睡前都读小说。
senses.why: The core image is a world written into existence, so the first sense is the written imagined story.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是「被写出来的世界」，所以第一个义项就是成文的想象故事。

senses.title: Something invented and untrue
senses.definition: a claim or account that has been invented and is not true
senses.definitionCN: 被编造出来、并非真实的说法或叙述
senses.example: The report was pure fiction from start to finish.
senses.exampleCN: 那份报告从头到尾纯属虚构。
senses.why: The same imagined world leaves the page and pretends to be fact.
senses.whyCN: 同样的想象世界离开了书页，假装成事实，于是有了谎义。

senses.title: The act or category of inventing stories
senses.definition: the activity or genre of creating imagined stories as opposed to fact
senses.definitionCN: 与事实相对的、创作想象故事的门类或行为
senses.example: Fact and fiction overlap in his novels.
senses.exampleCN: 在他的小说里，事实与虚构相互交叠。
senses.why: Fiction names the whole territory where invention is allowed.
senses.whyCN: fiction 为「允许编造」的整个疆域命名，成为体裁概念。

intro.en: Fiction comes from a Latin verb about shaping and molding.
intro.cn: fiction 源自一个表示塑造、捏制的拉丁语动词。

items.en: Latin fingere meant to shape or mold, and fictio meant a shaping or feigning.
items.cn: 拉丁语 fingere 意为塑造，fictio 指一次塑造或假装。

items.en: Old French carried ficcion into Europe with the sense of invented account.
items.cn: 古法语以 ficcion 的形式传入欧洲，带有编造叙述的含义。

items.en: Middle English ficcioun first meant a false statement or pretense.
items.cn: 中古英语 ficcioun 先指虚假陈述或借口。

items.en: The modern sense of imagined literature became central over time.
items.cn: 现代英语中想象性文学的义项逐渐成为中心。

items.en: The modern language keeps the word in daily use.
items.cn: 现代英语仍在日常使用该词。

note.en: Fiction sits next to novel and legend but they are not the same size of word.
note.cn: fiction 与 novel、legend 相邻，但词的范围大小不同。

entries.definition: adjective meaning invented, not real
entries.definitionCN: 形容词：虚构的、非真实的

entries.definition: adjective from the same Latin root, meaning made up
entries.definitionCN: 同根形容词：编造的、假想的

entries.definition: rubbing force between surfaces; only one letter apart
entries.definitionCN: 摩擦（力）；与 fiction 只差一个字母，词源不同

entries.definition: a long written fictional story in book form
entries.definitionCN: 长篇虚构故事书，是 fiction 的一种具体形式

entries.definition: an old story that may mix history and imagination
entries.definitionCN: 古老传说，介于史实与想象之间

entries.definition: highly imaginative fiction about impossible worlds
entries.definitionCN: 奇幻作品，想象力更放开的 fiction 分支

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to fix fiction in your memory.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子把 fiction 钉进记忆。

normal.en: Fiction shares its root with figure: a shaped form rather than a real person.
normal.cn: fiction 与 figure 同根：是被塑造的形象，而非真人。

normal.en: Science fiction is the most famous member of the family.
normal.cn: science fiction 是这个家族最有名的成员。

normal.en: A lie is fiction pretending to be news.
normal.cn: 谎言是假装成新闻的 fiction。

normal.en: Fiction ends in -tion like creation: both make something from nothing.
normal.cn: fiction 以 -tion 结尾，与 creation 一样：都从无到有。

normal.en: Bookshop signs use Fiction over the shelves of invented stories.
normal.cn: 书店的 Fiction 标牌下面摆的全是虚构故事。

abstract.en: Fiction is a door in the page: step in and the world exists.
abstract.cn: fiction 是书页里的一扇门：踏进去，世界就存在。

abstract.en: Picture ink shaping itself into people who never lived.
abstract.cn: 想象墨水把自己捏成从未活过的人。

abstract.en: Between fact and dream there is a workshop; its name is fiction.
abstract.cn: 在事实与梦之间有一间工坊，它的名字叫 fiction。

examples.en: Journey to the West blends fact and fiction.
examples.cn: 《西游记》混合了事实与虚构。

examples.en: The rumor turned out to be complete fiction.
examples.cn: 那谣言原来是彻头彻尾的编造。

examples.en: He won a prize for his first work of fiction.
examples.cn: 他凭第一部虚构作品得了奖。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「飞克身」——小说里的主人公飞起来克服地心引力的身姿；fiction 是飞出真实身形的想象

root: 拉丁语 fingere（塑造、捏制）的派生名词 fictio（塑造之物、假托之事），经古法语进入英语；同根词有 figure、fictitious。

sensesIntro.en: From shaped stories on the page to lies off the page.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从纸上被塑造的故事，扩展到纸外的假话与体裁概念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a world shaped by ink
core.cn: 核心意象：被墨水塑造出来的世界

branches.en: the invented claim off the page

branches.cn: 允许编造的整个体裁疆域
书店里标着小说的书架

intro.en: Fiction carries the Latin noun ending -tion and keeps a wide family.
intro.cn: fiction 带着拉丁名词后缀 -tion，词族庞大。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root fingere means to shape, and it feeds many English words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 fingere 意为塑造，滋养了许多英语词。

items.example: Fiction is a shaping of the unreal.
items.exampleCN: fiction 是对不真实之物的塑造。

items.example: Creation and fiction share this ending.
items.exampleCN: creation 与 fiction 共用这个后缀。

items.example: Sherlock Holmes is a fictional detective.
items.exampleCN: 福尔摩斯是虚构的侦探。

items.meaning: an invented thing, usually an idea
items.example: The monster was a figment of her imagination.
items.exampleCN: 那怪物是她想象的产物。

items.example: A dark figure stood at the gate.
The film is a docufiction about fishing towns.
items.exampleCN: 这部电影是关于渔镇的纪录式虚构作品。

items.example: Pulp fiction magazines flourished long ago.
items.exampleCN: 通俗小说杂志曾盛极一时。

definition_zh: 第五；五分之一
definition_en: coming after four others in order, or one of five equal parts
core_image: 队伍里数到五的那个：四个在前，它排最后
scene: 运动会领奖台上站着一排选手，老师举着号码牌。She finished fifth in the school race.
sceneCN: 这里 fifth 是「第五」（第 1 个义项：序数第五）；句意为她在校运会赛跑中获得第五名。

pos.zh: 数词：第五（序数）
名词：五分之一；（音乐）五度音程

derivatives.zh: 基数词，是 fifth 的基数来源
第五；第十五的序数形式，由 five 系列加后缀构成
五十，同一数词家族的高位成员

senses.title: Number five in a series
senses.definition: position number five when counting in order
senses.definitionCN: 按顺序数到的第五个位置
senses.example: Her office is on the fifth floor.
senses.exampleCN: 她的办公室在五楼。
senses.why: The core image is a counted lineup, and this sense names the slot after four.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是排好序的队伍，这个义项点名四之后的位置。

senses.title: One of five equal parts
senses.definition: one part when a whole is divided into five equal pieces
senses.definitionCN: 整体均分为五份后的一份
senses.example: A fifth of the students joined the club.
senses.exampleCN: 五分之一的学生加入了社团。
senses.why: The same lineup is folded into fractions: five slots make one share.
senses.whyCN: 同一支队伍被折进分数：五个位置合成一份。

senses.title: A musical interval
senses.definition: the interval between two notes five scale steps apart
senses.definitionCN: 音阶上相距五步的两个音之间的音程
senses.example: The song opens with a rising fifth.
senses.exampleCN: 这首歌以一个上行的五度开头。
senses.why: Five steps of the scale form one musical distance.
senses.whyCN: 音阶上的五步构成一个音乐距离，数数义长出乐理义。

intro.en: Fifth is five with an ordinal ending, rebuilt along Old English lines.
intro.cn: fifth 就是 five 加序数后缀，沿古英语路径构成。

items.en: A Germanic numeral family for five underlies the word.
items.cn: 词的基础是表示「五」的日耳曼数词家族。

items.en: Old English fifta was the ordinal form of five.
items.cn: 古英语 fifta 是 five 的序数形式。

items.en: Middle English shifted the ending to fifthe, then fifth.
items.cn: 中古英语词尾变为 fifthe，再到 fifth。

items.en: The spelling stabilized as fifth with the -th ordinal ending.
items.cn: 现代英语拼写定为 fifth，用 -th 序数后缀。

items.en: The modern language keeps the word in daily use.
items.cn: 现代英语仍在日常使用该词。

note.en: Fifth is easy to misspell because the v of five disappears.
note.cn: fifth 容易拼错，因为 five 的 v 消失了。

entries.definition: the ordinal of fifteen, not of five
entries.definitionCN: 第十五的序数词，属于 fifteen 系列

entries.definition: the cardinal fifty
an incorrect spelling of fifth
entries.definitionCN: fifth 的错误拼法，少了配平的字母

entries.definition: the ordinal before fifth
entries.definitionCN: 第四，排在 fifth 前一位的序数词

entries.definition: the ordinal after fifth
entries.definitionCN: 第六，排在 fifth 后一位的序数词

entries.definition: a statistics term for one of five equal groups
entries.definitionCN: 统计学里五等分中的一份，术语说法

normalIntro.en: Five hooks for the ordinal fifth.
normalIntro.cn: 第五的第五条钩子。

normal.en: Five drops its v and grows -th to become fifth.
normal.cn: five 丢掉 v，长出 -th，变成 fifth。

normal.en: The fifth floor is one flight above the fourth.
normal.cn: 五楼在四楼上面一层。

normal.en: Divide a cake five ways and each piece is a fifth.
normal.cn: 蛋糕切成五份，每份是五分之一。

normal.en: In music class, do-re-mi-fa-sol spans a fifth.
normal.cn: 音乐课上 do 到 sol 正好是五度。

normal.en: May the fifth sounds like a birthday cheer for fifth.
normal.cn: 五月五日读起来就是给 fifth 的生日欢呼。

abstract.en: Picture five runners and the tape held by the last one.
abstract.cn: 想象五个赛跑者，最后的那个抓着终点带。

abstract.en: A pizza cut into five even slices: one slice, one fifth.
abstract.cn: 一张披萨切成五等片：一片就是五分之一。

abstract.en: Count stairs one to five and let your hand land on five.
abstract.cn: 从一数到五级台阶，让手落在第五级。

examples.en: This is the fifth time I have called him.
examples.cn: 这是我第五次给他打电话。

examples.en: About one fifth of the class went on the trip.
examples.cn: 大约五分之一的同学参加了这次旅行。

examples.en: She finished fifth in the spelling contest.
examples.cn: 她在拼字比赛中获得第五名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「菲夫斯」——五个选手里的第五位，菲（非）前三也非第四；fifth 就是数到五的那位

root: 日耳曼数词 five（古英语 fif）加序数后缀 -th（古英语 -ta/-þa）构成；属本土数词系统，无拉丁词根。

sensesIntro.en: One counted slot branches into fractions and music intervals.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个数出来的位置，分出分数与音程两条支路。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the slot right after four
core.cn: 核心意象：紧随第四之后的位置

branches.en: floors and ranks in daily counting
branches.cn: 日常数数的楼层与名次

intro.en: Fifth shows the plain ordinal machinery of English numerals.
intro.cn: fifth 展示了英语数词朴素的序数机制。

latinIntro.en: No Latin relatives: the numeral family is native Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词：数词家族是本土日耳曼的。

items.example: Fif- runs through five, fifty and fifth.
items.exampleCN: fif- 贯穿 five、fifty 与 fifth。

items.example: Fourth, fifth and sixth all use -th.
Her birthday is on the fifteenth.
One fifth of the cake is gone.

items.meaning: refuse to answer to avoid self-incrimination
items.meaningCN: 拒绝作答以免自证其罪
items.example: He took the fifth in court.
items.exampleCN: 他在法庭上选择了沉默权。

items.example: The chord adds a perfect fifth.

items.meaning: a learner who has drilled intervals
items.example: Her ear for fifths is sharp.

definition_zh: 电影；影片；胶卷；薄膜；拍摄
definition_en: a movie, the thin coating on a surface, or the act of recording with a camera
core_image: 一层会讲故事的膜：早期电影正是涂在薄胶片上的影子
scene: 老式放映机把光打在幕布上，观众席渐渐安静。They filmed the whole ceremony in one afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 film 作动词「拍摄」（第 3 个义项：用摄影机记录）；句意为他们用一个下午拍完了整场典礼。

pos.zh: 名词：电影；胶片；薄膜
动词：拍摄；把……拍成电影

derivatives.zh: film 加 maker 构成，指电影制作人
加形容词后缀，义为「薄雾般的、朦胧的」
micro 加 film，指缩微胶片

senses.title: A thin layer on a surface
senses.definition: a thin layer of something covering a surface
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖在表面上的某种薄层
senses.example: A film of oil floated on the water.
senses.exampleCN: 水面上浮着一层薄油。
senses.why: The core image is a skin-thin coating, which is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是薄如皮肤的一层膜，这是最古老的义项。

senses.title: A movie
senses.definition: a story recorded as moving pictures shown in a cinema or on screens
senses.definitionCN: 以活动影像形式放映的故事
senses.example: We watched a film about the polar bears.
senses.exampleCN: 我们看了一部关于北极熊的电影。
senses.why: Early movies were literally moving pictures on a thin film, so the movie sense grew out of the coating.
senses.whyCN: 早期电影正是拍在薄胶片上的活动影像，电影义从涂层义长出。

senses.title: To record with a camera
senses.definition: to use a camera to record moving pictures
senses.definitionCN: 用摄影机记录活动影像
senses.example: The crew filmed the interview at the harbor.
senses.exampleCN: 摄制组在海港拍摄了那次访谈。
senses.why: If the picture lives on film, making it is filming.
senses.whyCN: 影像活在胶片上，制作它就是拍摄。

senses.title: A thin haze over the eyes
senses.definition: a thin layer of tears or mist that blurs the sight
senses.definitionCN: 泪水或雾气形成的薄层，使视线模糊
senses.example: Tears filmed over her eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 泪水在她眼里蒙上了一层雾。
senses.why: The coating sense applies to the eye itself.
senses.whyCN: 涂层义套用到了眼睛上。

intro.en: Film first meant any thin skin, and only later grew into cinema.
intro.cn: film 先泛指薄皮，后来才长出电影义。

items.en: Old English film meant a thin skin, such as a membrane.
items.cn: 古英语 film 指薄皮、薄膜。

items.en: The thin-layer sense continued through Middle English.
items.cn: 薄层义贯穿中古英语。

items.en: Photographers called coated celluloid film, and movies took the name.
items.cn: 现代英语中摄影者把涂感光乳剂的赛璐珞称为 film，电影因此得名。

items.en: The verb to film followed the noun into cinema language.
items.cn: 动词 to film 随名词进入电影用语。

items.en: The modern language keeps the word in daily use.
items.cn: 现代英语仍在日常使用该词。

note.en: Film crosses movies, coatings and cameras, which trips up many learners.
note.cn: film 横跨电影、涂层与相机，学习者容易绊倒。

entries.definition: adjective meaning thin and misty
entries.definitionCN: 形容词：如薄膜般朦胧的

entries.definition: one letter shorter; to make full
entries.definitionCN: 填满；与 film 仅差一字母

entries.definition: a factory with heavy machines; similar shape
entries.definitionCN: 磨坊、工厂；字形相近但词源不同

entries.definition: the everyday American word for a film
the place where films are shown
a thin soft layer in biology
entries.definitionCN: 生物学中的薄膜，对应 film 的旧义

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to keep film in focus.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子让 film 保持对焦。

normal.en: Old movies ran on strips of film, thin as a skin.
normal.cn: 老电影跑在薄如皮肤的一卷卷胶片上。

normal.en: A film of dust on the desk means nobody cleaned it.
normal.cn: 桌上的一层薄灰说明没人打扫。

normal.en: Go to the cinema and you see a film, not a membrane.
normal.cn: 去电影院看的是电影，不是薄膜。

normal.en: Filmy curtains are as thin as a film layer.
normal.cn: 薄纱窗帘像薄膜一样薄。

normal.en: The crew filmed the scene twice because of the rain.
normal.cn: 因为下雨，剧组把那场戏拍了两遍。

abstract.en: Film is a skin that remembers light.
abstract.cn: film 是一层记得住光的皮肤。

abstract.en: Picture a pond wearing a coat of oil.
abstract.cn: 想象一个池塘披着油的外套。

abstract.en: Every movie is a membrane between you and another life.
abstract.cn: 每部电影都是你与另一种人生之间的一层膜。

examples.en: That film made everyone in the hall laugh.
examples.cn: 那部电影让全场的人都笑了。

examples.en: A film of ice covered the quiet lake.
examples.cn: 一层薄冰覆盖着安静的湖面。

examples.en: They filmed the parade from a rooftop.
examples.cn: 他们在屋顶上拍摄了游行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「菲尔姆」——胶片薄薄一层像菲薄的膜；film 就是那层记录影像的膜

root: 古英语 film（薄膜），一般认为源自表示「皮、膜」的日耳曼词根；现代的电影义由感光胶片义发展而来，非拉丁来源。

sensesIntro.en: From thin coating to moving pictures and back to misty eyes.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从薄涂层出发，长出电影与拍摄，又回到眼前的薄雾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a skin-thin layer that holds light
core.cn: 核心意象：薄如皮肤、能留住光的一层

branches.en: any thin layer on a surface
the story shown from the strip

intro.en: Film is a short Old English noun that later built compounds freely.
intro.cn: film 是短小的古英语名词，后来大量参与构词。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives are absent; compounds were formed inside English.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词，复合词都在英语内部构成。

items.example: Old film named membranes before cinema.
items.exampleCN: cinema 出现前，古英语 film 已指薄膜。

items.example: The film star waved to the crowd.
Libraries kept old newspapers on microfilm.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆用缩微胶片保存旧报纸。

items.example: They made a telefilm about the flood.
items.exampleCN: 他们拍了一部关于洪水的电视电影。

items.example: A filmy skirt floated in the wind.
The moment is on film forever.
She covered the bowl with cling film.

items.meaning: to become covered with a thin layer
items.example: His eyes filmed over with tears.

items.meaning: the music written for a film
items.example: The film score swelled at the ending.

latinEntries.example: Membrane is the Latin cousin of the coating sense.
latinEntries.exampleCN: membrane 是涂层义的拉丁表亲。

definition_zh: 最后的；最终的；决定性的；决赛
definition_en: coming at the end, not to be changed, or the last game of a contest
core_image: 画上句号的那一笔：前面再长，都归结到终点
scene: 比分牌上两支队伍追平，只剩最后一投。The final shot decided the whole match.
sceneCN: 这里 final 是「决定性的、最后的」（第 1 个义项：在最后且不可更改）；句意为最后一投决定了整场比赛。

pos.zh: 形容词：最后的；最终的；决定性的
名词：决赛；期末考试（常用复数）

derivatives.zh: 加副词后缀，义为「最后；终于」
加动词后缀，义为「把……最后定下来」
同根借自意大利语，指乐章或演出的终场
加施动者后缀，指进入决赛的选手

senses.title: Coming at the end
senses.definition: happening or coming at the end of a series or process
senses.definitionCN: 出现在一系列事物的末尾
senses.example: The final bus leaves at eleven.
senses.exampleCN: 末班车十一点发车。
senses.why: The core image is the closing stroke of a series, so the first sense marks the end slot.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一连串事物的收尾一笔，第一个义项标记终点位置。

senses.title: Decided and not to be changed
senses.definition: fixed and impossible to change after discussion
senses.definitionCN: 一经作出便不可再改
senses.example: The judge's word was final.
senses.exampleCN: 法官的话是最终裁定。
senses.why: What ends the process also closes the argument.
senses.whyCN: 结束流程的东西也终结了争论，于是有定论义。

senses.title: The last game of a competition
senses.definition: the last and deciding game or round of a contest
senses.definitionCN: 比赛中最后一场、定胜负的一轮
senses.example: Our team reached the final.
senses.exampleCN: 我们队打进了决赛。
senses.why: The end slot of the contest gets its own name.
senses.whyCN: 比赛的终点位置单独得名，成了名词决赛。

senses.title: End-of-term examinations
senses.definition: the important examinations at the end of a school term or course
senses.definitionCN: 学期或课程末尾的重要考试
senses.example: Finals week is the quietest week on campus.
senses.exampleCN: 考试周是校园里最安静的一周。
senses.why: Another end point of school life takes the same closing word.
senses.whyCN: 校园生活的另一个终点套用了同一个收尾词。

intro.en: Final traces back to Latin finis, the word for an end or boundary.
intro.cn: final 溯源到拉丁语 finis，表示终点、边界。

items.en: Latin finis meant an end or limit, and finalis meant relating to the end.
items.cn: 拉丁语 finis 指终点或界限，finalis 表示与终点相关。

items.en: Finalis stayed in learned use for anything at the end.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 finalis 在书面语中指处于末尾之物。

items.en: Old French final carried the word toward English.
items.cn: 古法语 final 把这个词带向英语。

items.en: Middle English final meant last in order or time.
items.cn: 中古英语 final 表示顺序或时间上的最后。

items.en: The contest and exam senses developed in the modern period.
items.cn: 现代英语发展出决赛与期末考试义。

note.en: Final, last and ultimate sit in the same corner of meaning.
note.cn: final、last、ultimate 挤在同一个意义角落。

entries.definition: adverb meaning at last
the closing part of a performance
the ornament on top of a spire; only one letter apart
entries.definitionCN: 尖顶饰；与 final 仅差一字母，词义无关

entries.definition: the everyday word for coming after all others
entries.definitionCN: 日常用词：排在所有其他之后的

entries.definition: formal word for the greatest or final degree
entries.definitionCN: 正式用语：终极的、最后的

entries.definition: at the very end, often of a route or disease
entries.definitionCN: 极终的；常指线路或病程的末端

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to finish off final.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子给 final 收尾。

normal.en: Final shares its root with finish and fine: an end line.
normal.cn: final 与 finish、fine 同根：一条终点线。

normal.en: The final whistle ends the football match.
normal.cn: 终场哨声结束足球赛。

normal.en: When a decision is final, the door is shut.
normal.cn: 决定一旦 final，门就关上了。

normal.en: Reaching the final means you survived every earlier round.
normal.cn: 打进决赛意味着你赢下了之前每一轮。

normal.en: Finals week fills the library with tired students.
normal.cn: 期末考试周把图书馆塞满疲惫的学生。

abstract.en: Final is the full stop at the end of a long sentence.
abstract.cn: final 是长句末尾的句号。

abstract.en: Picture a finish line tape stretched across the road.
abstract.cn: 想象横在路面上的终点线带。

abstract.en: Everything before it exists so that the final can arrive.
abstract.cn: 之前的一切都是为了迎接 final 的到来。

examples.en: This is my final warning.
examples.cn: 这是我的最后一次警告。

examples.en: She reached the final of the singing contest.
examples.cn: 她进入了歌唱比赛的决赛。

examples.en: The court's final decision came yesterday.
examples.cn: 法院的最终判决昨天下达。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 faire 你哦」不对，换一个：「法有你哦」——最后裁决法在你这，final 就是定案的最后一次

root: 拉丁语 finis（终点、界限）→ finalis（末尾的）→ 古法语 final → 英语 final；同根词有 finish、finite、infinite。

sensesIntro.en: The end slot of a series branches into fixed decisions, contests and exams.
sensesIntro.cn: 系列的终点位置分出定论、决赛与期末考试三支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the stroke that closes the series
core.cn: 核心意象：给系列画上句号的那一笔

branches.cn: 来自 finis 的边界概念

intro.en: Final keeps the Latin adjective shape and spawns a busy family.
intro.cn: final 保留拉丁形容词形态，衍生出一个繁忙的词族。

latinIntro.en: The root finis means end, and it feeds finish, finite and infinite.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 finis 意为终点，滋养了 finish、finite、infinite。

items.example: All fin- words point to an end.
items.exampleCN: 所有 fin- 词都指向终点。

items.example: Final means relating to the end.

items.meaning: the closing part of a show

items.example: In the final analysis, effort matters.
The finalist round starts at noon.

latinEntries.example: Finis crowned old books as the last word.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 旧书末页常以 finis 作结。

definition_zh: 最后；终于；完全地；最终地
definition_en: after a long time or after everything else, or in a way that ends something for good
core_image: 长队排到头的那一步：等了很久，终点终于踩到脚下
scene: 候车厅里的人已等了两个小时，广播忽然响起。The delayed train finally pulled into the station.
sceneCN: 这里 finally 是「终于」（第 1 个义项：久等之后发生）；句意为晚点的火车终于进站了。

pos.zh: 副词：终于（久等之后）；最后（列举末项）
副词：彻底地；最终决定性地

derivatives.zh: 形容词来源词，义为「最后的、决定性的」
同根动词，义为「最后敲定」
同根名词，指演出的终场

senses.title: After a long wait
senses.definition: after waiting or trying for a long time, something happens
senses.definitionCN: 经过长久等待或努力之后，某事发生
senses.example: The rain finally stopped before noon.
senses.exampleCN: 雨终于在中午前停了。
senses.why: The core image is reaching the end of a long queue of time, so the sense adds relief.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是走完时间的长队，义项因此带上如释重负的语气。

senses.title: As the last item
senses.definition: used to introduce the last point in a list or speech
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出列举或讲话的最后一项
senses.example: Finally, remember to lock the door.
senses.exampleCN: 最后，记得锁门。
senses.why: The queue idea applies to spoken items as well as events.
senses.whyCN: 排队意象同样适用于话头：最后一项排在队尾。

senses.title: In a decisive, settled way
senses.definition: in a way that settles something completely and leaves no further dispute
senses.definitionCN: 以彻底解决、不再有争议的方式
senses.example: The border question was finally settled.
senses.exampleCN: 边界问题得到彻底解决。
senses.why: The final stroke ends not just a list but an argument.
senses.whyCN: 收尾的一笔结束的不只是清单，还有争论，于是长出定局义。

intro.en: Finally is simply final wearing an adverb ending.
intro.cn: finally 就是 final 加上副词词尾。

items.en: Latin finis meant an end or boundary.
items.cn: 拉丁语 finis 意为终点、界限。

items.en: Finalis described whatever stood at the end.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 finalis 形容处于末尾之物。

items.en: Old French final passed the adjective to English.
items.cn: 古法语 final 把形容词传给英语。

items.en: The adjective final was established in Middle English.
items.cn: 中古英语中形容词 final 已经定型。

items.en: The adverb finally formed with the native -ly ending.
items.cn: 现代英语用本族 -ly 词尾构成副词 finally。

note.en: Finally overlaps with at last and lastly, each with its own flavor.
note.cn: finally 与 at last、lastly 交叠，各自味道不同。

entries.definition: in small pieces or finely made; only one letter apart
entries.definitionCN: 细小地；精美地；与 finally 仅差一个字母

entries.definition: the adjective source of the adverb
the quality of being final
same relief, usually one clause long
entries.definitionCN: 终于，语气近似，多用于单句

entries.definition: introduces the last list item, no relief feeling
entries.definitionCN: 列举最后项，没有「久等」的意味

entries.definition: in the end, over a long period, less emotional
entries.definitionCN: 最终，强调长过程，情绪色彩更弱

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to hold finally in place.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子把 finally 安放妥当。

normal.en: Finally is final with -ly: the end word turned into a step.
normal.cn: finally 是 final 加 -ly：终点词变成了一个步骤。

normal.en: The bus finally came after an hour of waiting.
normal.cn: 等了一小时，公交车终于来了。

normal.en: Speech contest judges hear finally as the closing signal.
normal.cn: 演讲比赛的听众把 finally 当作收尾信号。

normal.en: Finally settled means the matter will not reopen.
normal.cn: finally settled 表示事情不会再翻案。

normal.en: Firstly, secondly, finally build a neat speaking ladder.
normal.cn: firstly、secondly、finally 搭出整齐的演讲梯子。

abstract.en: Finally is the last stair of a very long staircase.
abstract.cn: finally 是超长楼梯的最后一级。

abstract.en: Hear the door click: the wait is over.
abstract.cn: 听见门咔哒一声：等待结束了。

abstract.en: Everything before finally was just the road.
abstract.cn: finally 之前的一切只是道路。

examples.en: He finally passed the driving test.
examples.cn: 他终于通过了驾照考试。

examples.en: Finally, I want to thank my teachers.
examples.cn: 最后，我想感谢我的老师们。

examples.en: The dispute was finally settled last month.
examples.cn: 那场争端上个月得到最终解决。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「 faire 你」不对，用这个：「发你哦」——等了很久，结果终于发给你了；finally 就是终于发到你手上

root: 拉丁语 finis（终点）→ finalis → 古法语 final → 英语 final + 本族副词后缀 -ly；同根词有 finish、infinite。

sensesIntro.en: From relieved waiting to list endings and settled outcomes.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从久等后的释然，走向列举收尾与彻底定局。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stepping onto the last stair after a long climb
core.cn: 核心意象：长攀之后踏上的最后一级台阶

branches.en: the closing item of a speech

intro.en: Finally shows the native -ly adverb machine on a Latin adjective.
intro.cn: finally 展示了本族 -ly 副词机制套在拉丁形容词上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root finis feeds the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 finis 支撑起整个词族。

items.example: The final page has no number.
Quick becomes quickly, final becomes finally.
items.exampleCN: quick 变 quickly，final 变 finally。
fin- 标记每个表示结束的词。
她的语气带着定局的意味。

items.example: The parade had a fireworks finale.
At last the exam was over.

definition_zh: 手指；指头；指状物；用手指触碰
definition_en: one of the long parts of the hand, a finger-shaped part, or to touch with fingers
core_image: 手掌伸出的五根细枝：抓、点、数的工具
scene: 钢琴老师轻敲琴键，示意学生跟着按。She pressed a key with her little finger.
sceneCN: 这里 finger 是「手指」（第 1 个义项：手上的指头）；句意为她用小指按了一个琴键。

pos.zh: 名词：手指；指状物
动词：用手指触碰、拨弄

derivatives.zh: finger 加 nail 的复合词，指甲
复合词，指尖
动名词转化，指（乐器）指法

senses.title: One of the parts of the hand
senses.definition: one of the five long bending parts at the end of the hand
senses.definitionCN: 手末端五根可以弯曲的长条部分
senses.example: She wore a ring on her middle finger.
senses.exampleCN: 她中指上戴着一枚戒指。
senses.why: The core image is the hand's five grasping branches, so the first sense names one branch.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是手掌伸出的五根抓握细枝，第一个义项给其中一根命名。

senses.title: A finger-shaped part
senses.definition: a narrow part shaped like a finger, such as part of a glove or a strip of land
senses.definitionCN: 形状像手指的狭长部分，如手套的指部或狭长地块
senses.example: A finger of land stretched into the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 一块狭长的陆地伸进湖里。
senses.why: Anything long and narrow borrows the hand's shape.

definition_zh: 伟大的；重大的；好极了；大量的
definition_en: very large in size or degree, very good, or important in rank or history
core_image: 被放大到顶的量：大到让人抬头看，好到让人叫出声
scene: 运动场边的人群起立欢呼，把帽子抛向空中。The great wall stretched far beyond the mountains.
sceneCN: 这里 great 是「巨大的、伟大的」（第 1 个义项：规模或程度极大）；句意为那道巨墙绵延远超群山。

pos.zh: 形容词：大的；大量的；伟大的；极好的

senses.title: Unusually large in size or amount
senses.definition: very big in size, number, or degree
senses.definitionCN: 在大小、数量或程度上非常大
senses.example: A great crowd gathered in the square.
senses.exampleCN: 一大群人聚集在广场上。
senses.why: The core image is quantity pushed to the top, so size comes first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是把数量推到顶，所以体量义最先出现。

senses.title: Very good or enjoyable
senses.definition: very good, pleasant, or enjoyable
senses.definitionCN: 非常好、令人愉快
senses.example: The concert was great from start to finish.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐会从头到尾都棒极了。
senses.why: What is large impresses, and what impresses is praised.
senses.whyCN: 大到令人惊叹，惊叹便化为称赞，于是有了夸赞义。

senses.title: Important or famous
senses.definition: important, powerful, or famous in history or society
senses.definitionCN: 在历史或社会中重要、有影响
senses.example: She is one of the great scientists of this age.
senses.exampleCN: 她是这个时代最伟大的科学家之一。
senses.why: Large size moves up to large reputation.
senses.whyCN: 体量之大升格为声名之大。

senses.title: One generation further up or down
senses.definition: used in family words to add one more generation, as in great-grandfather
senses.definitionCN: 用于亲属词再加一代，如 great-grandfather
senses.example: Her great grandmother lived through the old century.
senses.exampleCN: 她的曾祖母经历过上个世纪。
senses.why: Grand already means one step; great stacks one more step.
senses.whyCN: grand 已表隔一代，great 再叠一步，故成隔两代。

intro.en: Great is a native word for big that outgrew every synonym.
intro.cn: great 是本族的「大」，后来盖过了所有同义词。

items.en: A Germanic adjective family for coarse and thick underlies the word.

items.en: Old English great meant thick, coarse, or large.
items.cn: 古英语 great 意为粗的、厚的、大的。

items.en: Great displaced mickle as the everyday word for big.
items.cn: 中古英语中 great 取代 mickle 成为日常「大」字。

items.en: The praise sense and kinship use flourished in modern speech.
items.cn: 现代英语中夸赞义与亲属用法繁荣起来。

items.en: Daily speech keeps raising the bar for great.
items.cn: 日常口语不断提升 great 的使用频率。

note.en: Great, big and large divide the work of saying large.
note.cn: great、big、large 分工表达「大」。

definition_zh: 绿色的；青的；环保的；草地；绿化

senses.title: The colour of growing leaves
senses.definition: having the colour of fresh leaves or grass
senses.definitionCN: 有着新叶或青草的颜色
senses.example: The fields turn green again in April.
senses.exampleCN: 四月里田野重新变绿。
senses.why: The core image is the living leaf's colour, the first and central sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是活叶的颜色，这是最初也最中心的义项。

senses.title: Environmentally friendly
senses.definition: designed to protect the natural environment
senses.definitionCN: 以保护自然环境为目标的
senses.example: The city runs a green transport plan.
senses.exampleCN: 该市推行绿色交通计划。
senses.why: Leaf colour stands for living nature, so care for nature borrows it.
senses.whyCN: 叶色代表活着的自然，环保便借用了这个颜色。

senses.title: An area of grass
senses.definition: an area of grass, especially in a village or town
senses.definitionCN: 一片草地，尤指村镇的公共草坪
senses.example: Children played on the village green.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在村中草坪上玩耍。
senses.why: The colour names the carpet it paints.

senses.title: Inexperienced or unripe
senses.definition: young, untrained, or not yet ripe

senses.example: The new player is still green behind the ears.
senses.exampleCN: 新球员还是个生手。
senses.why: Unripe fruit shares the leaf's colour, so the inexperience follows.
senses.whyCN: 未熟的果子与叶子同色，生疏感随之而来。

definition_zh: 问候；迎接；欢迎；对……作出反应
definition_en: to welcome someone with words or signs, or to meet something with a reaction
core_image: 跨过门槛的那一声招呼：人和事一到，反应立刻出门迎接
scene: 清晨的校门口，值日生站在门边挥着手。Every student was greeted with a warm hello.
sceneCN: 这里 greet 是「问候、迎接」（第 1 个义项：以言语或动作欢迎）；句意为每位学生都受到热情的问候。

senses.title: To welcome with words or signs
senses.definition: to say hello or make a friendly sign when meeting someone
senses.definitionCN: 见面时打招呼或作友好的示意
senses.example: She greeted each guest at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她在门口迎接每一位客人。
senses.why: The core image is stepping toward the arriving person with a word ready.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是带着话迎向到来的人。

senses.title: To be received in a certain way
senses.definition: to be met with a particular reaction, often noise or silence
senses.definitionCN: 迎来某种反应，常是声音或沉默
senses.example: The news was greeted with cheers.
senses.exampleCN: 这消息迎来一片欢呼。
senses.why: The welcome sign also works for news and events.
senses.whyCN: 迎接的动作也适用于消息与事件。

senses.title: To come into one's senses first
senses.definition: to be the first thing seen, heard, or smelled on arrival
senses.definitionCN: 到达时最先被看见、听见或闻到
senses.example: The smell of coffee greeted us at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 门口先扑来咖啡的香味。
senses.why: Arriving things greet the senses like visitors.
senses.whyCN: 到来之物像访客一样问候感官。

senses.title: To react to with feeling
senses.definition: to show a feeling when facing something
senses.definitionCN: 面对某事物时表现出某种情绪
senses.example: The plan was greeted with doubt.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划遭到质疑。
senses.why: Every reaction is a greeting of its own kind.
senses.whyCN: 每一种反应都是一场别样的迎接。

normal.en: Old English greet could mean weep: emotion at the door.
normal.cn: 古英语 greet 可指流泪：门口的情绪。

abstract.en: Greet is the first step across the doorstep.
abstract.cn: greet 是跨过门槛的第一步。

abstract.en: A raised hand travels faster than feet.
abstract.cn: 举起的手比脚更快。

abstract.en: Every morning greets you; greet it back.
abstract.cn: 每个清晨都在向你问好，请回应它。

examples.en: He greeted his teacher politely every morning.
examples.cn: 他每天早晨都礼貌地向老师问好。

examples.en: The team was greeted by cheering fans.
examples.cn: 球队受到了球迷的欢呼迎接。

examples.en: A cold wind greeted us as we opened the door.
examples.cn: 开门时一股冷风扑面而来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「格里特」——客人一到就立刻迎接；greet 就是立刻迎上去的那声招呼

root: 古英语 gretan（接近、招呼），日耳曼动词族；肯特方言旧义为「流泪」，与拉丁语无亲缘。

sensesIntro.en: From hello at the door to reactions that arrive like visitors.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从门口的招呼，扩展到如访客般到来的反应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a word stepping out to meet what arrives
core.cn: 核心意象：迎着到来者跨出去的那句话

branches.en: the feeling shown to a plan

intro.en: Greet keeps a small, mostly native family.
intro.cn: greet 的词族不大，且以本族为主。

latinIntro.en: No Latin relatives; the verb stayed Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；动词保持日耳曼身份。

items.example: Old gretan even meant to weep in Kent.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 gretan 在肯特方言里竟指流泪。

items.example: He greets the dawn with a run.
The greeter stood by the door.
I bought a birthday greeting card.
They greeted the idea with laughter.
items.exampleCN: 他们以笑声回应这个想法。

definition_zh: 灰色的；灰白的；阴沉的；灰马；变灰
definition_en: of the colour between black and white, dull or pale, or to become grey-haired
core_image: 黑与白之间那条安静的中间色：阴天、水泥和老人的头发
scene: 天空压着厚厚的云，海面与天连成一片。The grey sky promised rain before noon.
sceneCN: 这里 grey 是「灰色的、阴沉的」（第 1 个义项：黑白之间的颜色）；句意为灰暗的天空预示中午前有雨。

pos.zh: 形容词：灰色的；灰白的；阴沉的；沉闷的
名词：灰色；灰马；灰衣（常复数）
动词：（头发）变灰白

derivatives.zh: 加后缀，义为「略带灰色的」
加后缀，义为「灰色；灰暗」
复合词，灵缇犬（旧义灰狗）

senses.title: The colour between black and white
senses.definition: of the dull colour made by mixing black and white
senses.definitionCN: 黑白混合出的暗淡颜色
senses.example: His umbrella was a plain grey.
senses.exampleCN: 他的伞是素灰色。
senses.why: The core image is the middle road between two extremes.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两个极端之间的中间道路。

senses.title: Dull or lifeless
senses.definition: dull, boring, or without hope or colour
senses.definitionCN: 乏味、无望或缺少生气
senses.example: The town has a grey winter feel.
senses.exampleCN: 这座小镇的冬天一片灰暗。
senses.why: The colour spreads from objects to moods.
senses.whyCN: 颜色从物体蔓延到心情。

senses.title: Grey-haired; becoming old
senses.definition: having hair that has turned grey with age
senses.definitionCN: 因年岁增长而头发变灰白
senses.example: A grey gentleman helped the children cross.
senses.exampleCN: 一位头发花白的先生帮孩子们过马路。
senses.why: Age paints the hair with the in-between colour.
senses.whyCN: 岁月给头发刷上了那种中间色。

senses.title: Unclear; between right and wrong
senses.definition: not clearly one thing or the other, especially morally or legally
senses.definitionCN: 在道德或规则上难以明确归边
senses.example: The contract has a grey area about overtime.
senses.exampleCN: 合同里加班问题存在灰色地带。
senses.why: The mixed colour fits mixed rules.
senses.whyCN: 混合的颜色恰好配混合的规则。

intro.en: Grey is an old Germanic colour word with two spellings today.
intro.cn: grey 是古老的日耳曼颜色词，如今有两种拼法。

items.en: Old English grǣg meant grey, of colour and hair alike.
items.cn: 古英语 grǣg 指灰色，兼指发色。

items.en: Old Norse grár may have reinforced the form.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 grár 可能强化了这一形式。

items.en: Middle English grey and gray both appear in texts.
items.cn: 中古英语文献中 grey 与 gray 并存。

items.en: British spelling settled on grey, American on gray.
items.cn: 现代英语英国拼法定为 grey，美国定为 gray。

items.en: Both spellings live on across the ocean.
items.cn: 两种拼法至今在大洋两岸并存。

note.en: Grey lives between black and white, in colour and in rules.
note.cn: grey 在颜色与规则上都住在黑白之间。

entries.definition: the American spelling of grey
slightly grey
animal fat; similar letters, no relation
entries.definitionCN: 油脂；字母相近而词义无关

entries.definition: lacking brightness or interest
entries.definitionCN: 暗淡乏味的，与灰义相接

entries.definition: pale grey like ash
shiny grey of polished metal or hair

normalIntro.en: Five hooks for the quietest colour.
normalIntro.cn: 给最安静颜色的五条钩子。

normal.en: Grey is what black and white make when they meet.
normal.cn: grey 是黑白相遇的结果。

normal.en: Old cameras took grey photographs.
normal.cn: 老相机拍的是灰度照片。

normal.en: Grey hair arrives one winter at a time.
normal.cn: 灰白的头发一年一年到来。

normal.en: A grey area is a rule without edges.
normal.cn: grey area 是没有边界的规则。

normal.en: British grey has an e, American gray has an a.
normal.cn: 英式 grey 用 e，美式 gray 用 a。

abstract.en: Grey is Sunday afternoon without plans.
abstract.cn: grey 是没有安排的周日午后。

abstract.en: Picture fog swallowing a whole street.
abstract.cn: 想象雾吞掉整条街。

abstract.en: Between yes and no lies a long grey road.
abstract.cn: 在与否之间，横着一条长长的灰路。

examples.en: The sky stayed grey all afternoon.
examples.cn: 天空整个下午都是灰的。

examples.en: Her hair turned grey in her forties.
examples.cn: 她四十多岁头发就白了。

examples.en: The rules left a grey area for small shops.
examples.cn: 规则给小店留下了灰色地带。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「格蕾」——黑白之间坐着安静的格蕾阿姨；grey 就是那位中间色的阿姨

root: 古英语 grǣg（灰），日耳曼颜色词，可能与古诺斯语 grár 互相强化；一般认为源自表「闪耀微光」的词根，存疑处已注明。

sensesIntro.en: From the middle colour to moods, age and moral margins.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从中间色出发，长出阴沉、苍老与规则边缘。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the quiet road between black and white
core.cn: 核心意象：黑白之间那条安静的路

intro.en: Grey stays compact but colours many compounds.
intro.cn: grey 保持短小，却染尽许多复合词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin relatives; this is native Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；这是本族日耳曼词。

items.example: Old grǣg named sky and hair alike.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 grǣg 兼指天色与发色。

items.example: Gray is standard in the US.
The greyness of morning eased slowly.
Privacy law has many grey areas.
items.exampleCN: 隐私法有很多灰色地带。

items.example: Use your grey matter before deciding.
Phones flowed through the grey market.
items.exampleCN: 手机经由灰色市场流通。
头发渐白的教授仍在跑步。

definition_zh: 地面；土地；场地；理由；基础； grounding（v.）使停飞； grounded
definition_en: the solid surface of the earth, an area for a purpose, or a reason for a belief
core_image: 脚踩住的那一层：一切楼、树、理由都从这里向上长
scene: 风筝越飞越远，孩子把它收回来抱在怀里。The kite finally landed on the wet ground.
sceneCN: 这里 ground 是「地面」（第 1 个义项：土地的表层）；句意为风筝最终落在湿漉漉的地面上。

pos.zh: 名词：地面；土地；场地；理由；基础
动词：使停飞；使 grounded（禁足）；把……建立在

collocations.zh: 开辟新天地；开创新局面

derivatives.zh: 加后缀，义为「无根据的」
复合词，基础工作
复合词，背景

senses.title: The surface of the earth
senses.definition: the top layer of the earth that people and things stand on
senses.definitionCN: 人站立的地球表层
senses.example: The box lay open on the ground.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子敞开着躺在地上。
senses.why: The core image is the layer your feet trust, the starting sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是脚所信赖的那一层，这是最初的义项。

senses.title: An area used for a purpose
senses.definition: an area of land used for a particular activity
senses.definitionCN: 用于特定活动的土地
senses.example: The school ground was full at break.
senses.exampleCN: 课间操场上全是人。
senses.why: Part of the earth's surface is fenced off for one job.
senses.whyCN: 地表的一部分被圈出来专供一事。

senses.title: A reason or basis
senses.definition: a reason for saying, doing, or believing something, often plural
senses.definitionCN: 说话做事相信的理由，常用复数
senses.example: There are good grounds for his complaint.
senses.exampleCN: 他的投诉有充分的根据。
senses.why: Reasons are what an argument stands on.
senses.whyCN: 理由是论证所站立的地基。

senses.title: To stop a plane or a child from going
senses.definition: to keep a plane from flying, or a child from going out as punishment
senses.definitionCN: 不让飞机起飞，或不让孩子外出作为惩罚
senses.example: The airline grounded its fleet during the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴期间航空公司停飞了全部机队。
senses.why: The grounded thing cannot leave the earth.
senses.whyCN: 被钉在地上者离不开地面，故有停飞与禁足。

senses.title: To base something on
senses.definition: to base an idea or practice on particular facts or principles
senses.definitionCN: 让想法或做法立足于特定事实或原则
senses.example: Her teaching is grounded in real cases.
senses.exampleCN: 她的教学立足于真实案例。
senses.why: Buildings stand on ground; so do ideas.
senses.whyCN: 楼立于地，观点亦然。

intro.en: Ground is the old word for the floor of the world.
intro.cn: ground 是「世界的地板」的古老说法。

items.en: A Germanic noun family for ground underlies the word.
items.cn: 词的基础是日耳曼语中表示地面的名词族。

items.en: Old English grund meant the bottom or ground.
items.cn: 古英语 grund 意为底部、地面。

items.en: Ground spread to fields, reasons and backgrounds.
items.cn: 中古英语中 ground 扩展到场地、理由与背景。

items.en: The aviation and parenting senses grew in the modern era.
items.cn: 现代英语中航空禁飞与家长禁足义发展起来。

items.en: Aviation slang fixed the grounded sense.
items.cn: 航空用语让 grounded 义固定下来。

note.en: Ground and earth meet under every sentence about land.
note.cn: 谈土地的每一句话里，ground 与 earth 都会相遇。

entries.definition: kept from flying; sensible
without any basis
to crush; its past form ground causes confusion
entries.definitionCN: 磨碎；其过去式与 ground 同形易混

entries.definition: the planet or the soil itself
the loose top layer where plants grow
the inside surface you walk on

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to keep your feet on the ground.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子让脚踩稳 ground。

normal.en: Stand your ground in a fair argument.
normal.cn: 在公正的争论中坚守立场。

normal.en: Common ground keeps old friends talking.
normal.cn: 共同话题让老朋友聊得下去。

normal.en: The ground floor is where you enter.
normal.cn: ground floor 是进门那层。

normal.en: Stormy weather grounds small planes.
normal.cn: 风暴天气让小飞机停飞。

normal.en: Grind its past tense is ground: flour was ground on the ground floor mill.
normal.cn: grind 的过去式是 ground：面粉在底层磨坊里磨成。

abstract.en: Ground is the world's oldest floor.
abstract.cn: ground 是世界上最老的地板。

abstract.en: Every argument needs somewhere to stand.
abstract.cn: 每个论点都需要立足之地。

abstract.en: Tie a kite and it returns to the ground.
abstract.cn: 系住风筝，它就会回到地面。

examples.en: The workers dug deep into the frozen ground.
examples.cn: 工人们挖进冰冻的地面深处。

examples.en: Both sides found common ground at last.
examples.cn: 双方最终找到了共同立场。

examples.en: The captain was grounded for breaking curfew.
examples.cn: 队长因违反宵禁被禁足。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「格朗德」——又大又宽托住万物的地；ground 就是那层格状的大地

root: 古英语 grund（底、地），日耳曼名词族；与 grind（磨）过去式同形属巧合，与拉丁语无亲缘。

sensesIntro.en: From the earth's floor to fields, reasons, flights and principles.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从大地之底，长出场地、理由、停飞与立论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the trusted layer under every foot
core.cn: 核心意象：每只脚信赖的那一层

branches.en: the land set aside for one use

intro.en: Ground is a workhorse compound element in English.
intro.cn: ground 是英语里劳苦功高的构词部件。

latinIntro.en: No Latin relatives; the family is native Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；词族是本族日耳曼的。

items.example: Old grund named the sea floor too.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 grund 也指海底。

items.example: The grounds were wet at dawn.
Check the background of the story.
An underground tunnel linked both banks.
items.exampleCN: 一条地下通道连接两岸。

items.example: The jar was buried in the ground.

latinEntries.example: Humus gave English humble and exhume.
latinEntries.exampleCN: humus 衍生了 humble 与 exhume。
